reads_archive.archive_note: index_file is the complete read list: one entry per eth_call, in order, failures included, each carrying the request as sent and the sha256 of the full response. Its sha256 is index_sha256 over the file's exact bytes. responses_file holds the full responses, one per line, in the same order, gzip-compressed with mtime=0 so the same content compresses to the same bytes. Together they make this run checkable for having been unaltered - anchored in git history, which is weaker than re-reading the chain and is stated as the weaker claim. Verify with code/verify_reads.py.
